data.gender_notes: Suvratika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Suvratika originates from Sanskrit and means 'one who follows good vows' or 'one who keeps sacred vows'. The name Suvratika carries the meaning “One with good vows” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Suvratika usually hope their child will grow to embody one with good vows and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing dedication, commitment, and adherence to dharma.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Suvratika total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
